subject: PHYSICS
description: ICSE 10th Physics: Force, Moment of Force, Work, Energy, Power and Machines

questions.question: What is the SI unit of moment of force?
questions.explanation: Moment of force = Force × Perpendicular distance, so SI unit is Newton-meter (N m).

questions.question: A body is in stable equilibrium when its center of gravity lies:
questions.explanation: A body is in stable equilibrium when its center of gravity is at its lowest position.

questions.question: Which class of lever always has Mechanical Advantage (M.A.) greater than 1?
questions.explanation: In a Class II lever, the effort arm is always longer than the load arm, so M.A. > 1.

questions.question: 1 kilowatt-hour (kWh) is equal to how many Joules?
For an ideal machine, the velocity ratio (V.R.) and mechanical advantage (M.A.) are related by:
questions.explanation: For an ideal machine with 100% efficiency, Efficiency = M.A. / V.R. = 1, so M.A. = V.R.

questions.question: When a force acts at right angles (90°) to the displacement, the work done is:
questions.explanation: W = F × s × cos(90°). Since cos(90°) = 0, work done is zero.
